title: Monster
source: Monster manga by Naoki Urasawa (162 chapters).
world: In 1986 Düsseldorf, Japanese neurosurgeon Kenzo Tenma saves a young boy, Johan Liebert, instead of the mayor. Years later he learns the boy grew into a charming, nameless monster who manipulates people into murder. Tenma, framed for Johan's crimes, chases him across post-reunification Germany and Czechoslovakia, uncovering the orphanage Kinderheim 511 and the experiments that shaped Johan and his twin sister Nina. A slow, realistic psychological thriller.
power_system: No powers. Johan's danger comes from manipulation, charisma and his ability to make people lose their sense of self.
